exposure: Location of care (rural facilities vs. referral facilities)
Provider specialty (Family Physicians with Enhanced Surgical Skills (FPESS) vs. regional specialists)
cohort: The study included patients who underwent colonoscopy, hernia repair, appendectomy, or cesarean delivery at one of seven rural hospitals or corresponding referral facilities in British Columbia between 2016 and 2021.
finding: The study found that the quality of care at rural facilities was at least equivalent to that at referral facilities for colonoscopy, hernia repair, and appendectomy, and that family physicians with enhanced surgical skills (FPESS) had outcomes at least equivalent to specialists for low-acuity patients.
